harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: (ووهبنا لهم من رحمتنا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to the second object. «عليًّا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «لسان».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «إنه كان» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of Moses. «نبيًا» is a second khabar (predicate) of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «وناديناه» is conjoined to the clause {وَكَانَ رَسُولا}; «نجيا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: (ووهبنا له من رحمتنا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «هارون» is a badal (substitute), and «نبيا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أخاه».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The clause «إنه كان» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إسماعيل».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: «عند»: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, «مرضيًا».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «إنه كان» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إدريس».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «مكانا» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause «ورفعناه» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّهُ كَانَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «الذين» is a badal (substitute) of the relative noun; the preposition phrase «من النبيين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «عليهم», and the second prepositional phrase is a badal of the first. The preposition phrase «وممَّن» is conjoined to «من ذرية» and is attached to what that is attached to. The conditional clause is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك», and His saying «سجَّدا» is a ḥāl of the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «فخلف» is resumptive, the clause «أضاعوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «خلف», and the clause «فسوف يلقون» is conjoined to the clause «اتبعوا».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «من» is a relative noun, accusative (manṣūb) as the excepted (in exception); «صالحًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «فأولئك يدخلون» is resumptive. «شيئا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: they will not be wronged with any wrong, little or much.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «جنات» is a badal (substitute) of {الْجَنَّةَ}, and «عدن» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The relative noun is a naʿt (adjective) of «جنات», and the preposition phrase «بالغيب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative's referent pronoun in «وعدها», i.e.: while it is unseen by them. The clause «إنه كان وعده مأتيا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «لا يسمعون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «جنات عدن»; «سلامًا» is a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ). The clause «ولهم رزقُهم» is conjoined to the clause «لا يسمعون». «بكرة» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the aforementioned "being established" (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) of «رزقهم» is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «تلك الجنة»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and badal (substitute); the relative noun is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. The preposition phrase «من عبادنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the «مَنْ» that follows.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The clause «وما نتنزل» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «بأمر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. «بين» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause), and the clause «له ما بين أيدينا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ربك».

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: «رب» is a badal (substitute) of {رَبِّكَ}; the clause «فاعبدْه» is resumptive, and so is the clause «هل تعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «ويقول» is resumptive. «ما» after «إذا» is redundant (zāʾida), and «إذا» is a conditional adverb (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) verb indicated by His saying «لسوف أُخْرَج», its implied form being: when I die, shall I be resurrected; it is not attached to «أخرج», because what comes after the lām does not govern what precedes it. The clause «لسوف أخرج» is explicative of the implied verb, and the lām is for emphasis (tawkīd).

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The clause «أوَلا يَذْكر» is conjoined to the earlier clause «يقول الإنسان», and the maṣdar «أنَّا خلقناه» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «ولم يك» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «خلقناه». «يك» is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with the sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the nūn, which was dropped for lightness.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: His saying «فَوَرَبِّك»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the wāw is a particle of oath and a preposition; «ربك» is a genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted "I swear" (أقسم). «الشياطين» is a noun conjoined to the hāʾ, and «جثيا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: His saying «أيُّهم أشد»: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «أشد» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: هو, and the clause «هو أشد» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عِتِيًّا», and «عِتِيًّا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: His saying «لنحن»: the lām occurs in the response to the preceding oath; the preposition phrase «بها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أولى»; «صِلِيًّا» is tamyīz (specification). The clause «ثم لنحن أعلم» is conjoined to the clause «ننزعَنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The wāw is resumptive and «إنْ» is negating; the preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: وإن أحد كائن منكم (and there is no one, being from among you,); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «واردها» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. The clause «كان» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «أيُّ» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «خير» is the khabar (predicate); «مقامًا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: «كم» is the predicative (khabariyya) kam, an object placed first; the preposition phrase «من قرن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «كَمْ». The clause «هم أحسن» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قرن», and the pronoun is made plural by construing it according to its meaning. «أثاثا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: «من»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «في الضَّلالة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «فلْيَمْدُد» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the lām is the lām of command which puts the verb in the jussive. «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the conditional clause is resumptive. «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إمَّا» is a particle of detailing (tafṣīl); «العذاب» is a badal (substitute) of «ما»; the clause «فسيعلمون» is the apodosis; «مكانًا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The two objects of «يزيد» are the relative noun and «هدى». The clause «يزيد» is resumptive, and the clause «والباقيات الصالحات خير» is conjoined to the resumptive one.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: His saying «أفرأيت»: the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is resumptive. The oath clause with its response is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb), and the clause «لأوتَيَنَّ» is the response to the oath; «مالا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: «الغيب» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), from their saying «اطَّلَعَ فُلانٌ الجبلَ», i.e. he climbed to its top. «أم» is a conjunction, and the clause «أَطَّلَع» is the second object of «أرأيت».

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: «كلا» is a particle of deterrence and rebuke (radʿ wa-zajr); «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «مدًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نَمُدَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «ما» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of the pronoun in «نَرِثُه», and «فَرْدًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun «نا».

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object; the preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عِزًّا».

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The preposition phrase «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ضِدًّا». «ضدًّا» was made singular even though it is a khabar (predicate) about a plural, because it is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun), and the maṣdar is singular and masculine.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: (ألم تر أنا أرسلنا الشياطين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of raʾā, and the clause «تَؤُزُّهُم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الشياطين».

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The clause «فلا تَعْجَل» is conjoined to the clause {أَرْسَلْنَا}.

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: «يوم» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) {نَعُدُّ}; «وفدًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «المتقين».

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: The clause «لا يملكون» is a second ḥāl (circumstantial) of {الْمُجْرِمِينَ}. «مَن» is a relative noun, excepted; the adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted second object.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The first object of «اتخذ» is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: Jesus.

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: (لقد جئتم شيئا إدا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The oath with its response is a resumptive clause; «إدًّا» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: «هَدًّا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and it is synonymous in meaning with the word governing it.

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: «أن» is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition: the lām.

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: The clause «وما ينبغي» is resumptive; the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of «ينبغي», and the verb «ينبغي» is made transitive with the lām.

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: «إن» is negating; «كل» is mubtadaʾ (subject); «مَن» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «آتي» is the khabar (predicate) of «كل»; «عبدا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «آتي», and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The clause «لقد أحصاهم» is the response to the oath, and the oath with its response is a resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: The clause «وكلهم آتيه» is conjoined to the preceding response to the oath; «فردا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «آتيه».

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: The preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) second object of jaʿala.

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The clause «فإنما يسَّرناه» is resumptive, and the genitive maṣdar «لتبشِّر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسَّرناه».

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: His saying «وكم»: the wāw is resumptive; «كم» is the predicative (khabariyya) kam, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and the preposition phrase «من قرن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «كم». The clause «هل تحس» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «منهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أحد», and the second «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida); «أحد» is the object of «تحس».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: His words «ذكر رحمة ربك عبده زكريا»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هذا (this). «عبده» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar (verbal noun) «رحمة»; «زكريا» is a badal (substitute) of «عبده».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «إذ نادى»: an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl), and the clause «نادى» is muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «ربِّ»: one addressed in the vocative, in construct, accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the dropped yāʾ. The preposition «مني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «العظم». «شيبًا» is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the fāʿil (agent), i.e.: واشتعل شيبُ الرأس (and the grey hair of the head blazed). The preposition «بدعائك» is attached to the khabar (predicate). The clause «ربِّ» is parenthetical between the noun of كان and its khabar, and the preposition «بدعائك» is attached to «شقيا».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The preposition «من ورائي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الموالي»; the clause «وكانت» is a ḥāl of the tāʾ in «خفت»; and the clause «فهب» is conjoined to the clause «إني خفت».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «يرثني» is a naʿt (adjective) of {وَلِيًّا}, and the clause «رب» is parenthetical between the two objects of «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «اسمه يحيى» is a naʿt (adjective) of «غلام», and likewise the clause «لم نجعل» is a second naʿt of «غلام». The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object; the preposition «من قبل» is attached to «نجعل».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «أنى»: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «غلام» is the noun of كان; the clause «وكانت» is a ḥāl of the yāʾ in «لي»; and the preposition «من الكبر» is attached to a ḥāl of «عتيا».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: His words «كذلك»: the kāf is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: الأمر كذلك (the matter is thus), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi. The preposition «عليَّ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar «هينٌ». The clause «وقد خلقتك» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the yāʾ in «عليَّ», and the clause «ولم تك» is conjoined to the circumstantial one. His words «تك»: a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with a sukūn implied on the dropped nūn.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ألا تكلم» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject); «ثلاث» is an adverb attached to «تكلم»; «سويًّا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تكلم».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: (على قومه من المحراب) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خرج», and «أنْ» is explicative (tafsīriyya). The clause «سبِّحوا» is explicative; «بكرة» is an adverb of time attached to the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The preposition «بقوة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «خذ». The clause «وآتيناه» is resumptive; «صبيا» is a ḥāl of the hāʾ. The clause «يا يحيى» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl) by an implied resumptive saying, i.e.: Allah said: O Yaḥyā.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «وحنانًا»: a noun conjoined to {الْحُكْمَ}, and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حنانًا». The clause «وكان» is conjoined to the clause «آتيناه».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: His words «وبَرًّا»: a noun conjoined to {تَقِيًّا}, and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «برًّا»; «عصيا» is a second khabar (predicate) of كان.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: His words «وسلام»: the wāw is a conjunction; «سلام» is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and «عليه» the khabar (predicate); beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it indicates a supplication. The clause «وسلام عليه» is conjoined to the clause «لم يكن». «يوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. «حيا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «يبعث».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «واذكر» is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) from «مريم»; «مكانًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and [what follows is] its naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «فاتخذت» is conjoined to the clause {انْتَبَذَتْ}; the preposition (مِنْ دُونِهِمْ) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. «سويا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بشرًا».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The preposition «منك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعوذ». The clause «إن كنت» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لأهب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رسول».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «أنى»: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause «ولم يمسسني بشر» is a ḥāl of the yāʾ in «لي»; and the clause «ولم أك» is conjoined to the circumstantial clause.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: His words «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل (like), the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: الأمر مثل ذلك (the matter is like that). The second clause «قال» is resumptive. The preposition «منا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of رحمة. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to an omitted verb, i.e.: خلقناه كذلك لنجعله (We created him thus that We might make him), and the implied clause is conjoined to the clause «هو عليَّ هين».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The preposition «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «انتبذت»; «مكانًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: His words «أجاءها» contain the sense of ألجأها (drove her), and the clause is conjoined to the clause «انتبذت». «يا» is a particle for drawing attention (tanbīh).

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative. The clause «قد جعل» is resumptive within the scope of the explanation. The adverb «تحتك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The preposition «إليك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being: أعني إليك (I mean: towards you). It may not be attached to «هُزِّي», because the verb of a connected pronoun does not pass over to its own connected pronoun outside the chapter of ظن and فقد; so one does not say: فرحتُ بي (I rejoiced in me) or ضربتُني (I struck me). The preposition «بجذع» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «هُزِّي», i.e.: shake the fresh dates, being on a trunk. The verb «تساقط» is jussive (majzūm), because it occurs as the apodosis of an implied condition.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: His words «فإما ترَيِنَّ»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «إن» is conditional, «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and the imperfect verb is jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn. Its original form before emphasis was تَرْأَيِِين: the kasra on the yāʾ was felt heavy and was dropped, so two quiescent letters met, and the final radical (lām al-kalima) was dropped, so it became تَرْأَيْن; the vowel of the hamza was transferred to the rāʾ, then the hamza was dropped for lightening, so it became تَرَيْن; then the jussive particle entered and the nūn of the nominative was dropped, so it became تَرَيْ; then it was emphasised with the nūn, so two quiescent letters met, and the yāʾ was given the vowel that suits it, the kasra, so it became تَرَيِنَّ. It is thus an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the yāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis. The preposition «من البشر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أحدًا». The clause «فلن أكلم» is conjoined to the clause «نذرْتُ».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «تحمله» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «أتت». The clause «يا مريمُ لقد جئت» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl); the clause of the oath with its apodosis is the response to the vocative, resumptive; and the clause «لقد جئت» is the apodosis of the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «كيف»: an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial); the preposition «في المهد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «صبيا».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «آتاني» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the noun of «إن»; «نبيًا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «أينما»: a conditional noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) كنت; «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); «كنت» is a complete past verb with its fāʿil (agent). «ما دمت»: «ما» is a temporal maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is an adverb of time attached to «أوصاني». The clause «أين ما كنت» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, and the clause «وَأَوْصَانِي» is conjoined to the clause «جعلني». The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «برا»: conjoined to {مُبَارَكًا}, and the preposition «بوالدتي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «برًّا». The clause «لم يجعلني» is conjoined to the earlier clause «جعلني».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «والسلام عليَّ» is conjoined to the clause «لم يجعلني». «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached; «حيا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «قول»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is implied, i.e.: أقول قول (I say a saying); the implied clause أقول is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يتخذ» is the noun of كان; the preposition «لله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of كان. The first object of «يتخذ» is implied, i.e.: أحدا (anyone), and «ولد» is the second object, «مِن» being redundant (zāʾida). «سبحانه» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «إذا» is a conditional adverb attached to the sense of the apodosis, and the conditional clause is resumptive. The clause «يكون» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: فهو يكون; and the clause «فهو يكون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «فاعبدوه» is conjoined to the clause «إن الله ربي». The clause «وإن الله ربي» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl) by an implied resumptive saying, and the clause «هذا صراط» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: His words «فويل للذين»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «ويل» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it indicates a supplication. The clause «فويل للذين» is conjoined to the preceding resumptive one. The preposition «من مشهد» is attached to the [notion of] being settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: His words «أسمع بهم»: a past verb in the form of the imperative; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the hāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); «أبصر» is like it, and its fāʿil was omitted because what precedes indicates it. The clause «يأتوننا» is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause of rectification (istidrāk) is resumptive; the adverb «اليوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The clause «وأنذرهم» is resumptive. «يوم» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is not an adverb, because the warning does not take place on that day. «إذ» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) from يوم. The clause «وهم في غفلة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object pronoun in «أنذرهم», and the clause «وهم لا يؤمنون» is conjoined to the clause «وهم في غفلة».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «نحن»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun in «إنَّا»; the clause «يرجعون» is conjoined to the resumptive «إنا نحن».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «إنه كان» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إبراهيم»; «نبيا» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of {إِبْرَاهِيمَ}. «يا أبتِ»: one addressed in the vocative, in construct, accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which has been replaced by a tāʾ, and it is muḍāf ilayhi. «لِمَ»: the lām is a preposition; «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive, whose alif was dropped because the preposition is joined to it, [the phrase being] attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تعبد». «شيئًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a little or much availing.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «ما»: a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «جاء». The clause «فاتبعني» is conjoined to the clause «جاءني». «أهدك» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the apodosis of an implied condition, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; its two objects are the kāf and «صراطا»; «سويًا»: a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «إن الشيطان كان» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يمسك» is the object of «أخاف». The preposition «من الرحمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب»; the clause «فتكون» is conjoined to the clause «يمسك»; the preposition «للشيطان» is attached to «وليًّا».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: His words «أراغب أنت»: the hamza is interrogative; «راغب» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «أنت» is a fāʿil (agent) standing in place of the khabar (predicate); and the preposition «عن آلهتي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «راغب». The clause «يا إبراهيم» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The lām in «لئن» prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa); the clause «لئن لم تنتهِ» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the clause «لأرجمَنَّك» is the apodosis of the oath, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «واهجرني» is conjoined to the clause «لئن لم تنته», and «مليًّا» is an adverb of time, i.e.: a long time, attached to «اهجر».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «سلام»: the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it indicates a supplication. The clause «سأستغفر» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the clause «إنه كان» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ربي».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «ما»: a relative noun conjoined to the kāf; the preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما». «عسى» is a complete past verb, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is the fāʿil (agent) of «عسى»; the clause «عسى» is resumptive. The preposition «بدعاء» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of كان, «شقيا».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «لما» is a particle of [one thing's] occurrence upon [another's] occurrence; the clause «وهبنا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). His words «وكلا»: a fronted first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «نبيا» is the second object.
